rows.location: cards.json FC2-c197 (L05, ungraded) vs L05.html:58-68 (Definition 1.1, Theorem 1.2)
rows.evidence: Front 'What is the parity cost in Lab 1?' back 'C - P - S + DK, the initial cost of the parity portfolio in the proof of Theorem 1.2. It is zero under parity (Definition 1.1; Theorem 1.2).' The first sentence matches L05.html:58-59 (Definition 1.1 names the parity cost and Lab 1). The second sentence states the Theorem 1.2 result but omits its hypotheses: L05.html:63-64 states 'Under A1, A2, A3, A4 and A5, C - P = S - e^{-r tau}K for every strike K > 0'. The verifier rule requires a card to carry a proposition's hypotheses, and 'under parity' is not a hypothesis of Theorem 1.2. The card also tests two facts (the formula and its zero value) while carrying no grade, although plan section 10 says to grade a derived parity result T.
rows.fix: Split into two cards. Keep 'What is the parity cost in Lab 1?' ungraded and answered by 'C - P - S + DK (Definition 1.1)'. Add 'Under A1 to A5, is the parity cost zero for every strike K > 0?' answered 'Yes, C - P - S + DK = 0 at every strike K > 0 (Theorem 1.2)', with grade T, matching c064's hypotheses.
